status: rejected experiment; not a production material or visual acceptance

source_patch.limit: Contains the rejected optical prototype plus its tested CPU vertex-colour fallback follow-up. The preview binary predates that CPU fallback follow-up; the regular GPU capture does not use vertex-colour fallback.

scope: A fine-canopy-gated litter/live-ground reflectance mixture in the existing material producer, plus a physical-footprint vertex-colour fallback. No terrain, ecology, placement, light, shader or GPU-layout changes.
rejection: Author defect inspection found large blurry green/brown patches, not resolved litter or convincing ground. Numerical contracts do not establish visual acceptance. The product prototype was removed rather than shipping it as the new default.

preview.scope: 10 seconds prestream / 8 measured frames, fixed WORLD00 standing view, silent/no HUD. Defect preview only; not a matched drained-stream performance/visual comparison.

results.workload: 512 serial canonical material pages, 128x128, six faces, levels 10..14
64 paired close-land pages, face 3, levels 14..17, counterbalanced order
64 paired close-land pages, face 3, levels 14..17, counterbalanced order

baseline_material_benchmark.scope: Retained baseline only. No post-change cost or speedup claim.

independent_blind_review: Not performed. An author may reject a defective candidate, but cannot self-certify preference/acceptance.
next_boundary: Resolved material structure and filtering at standing-camera scale, not stronger macro noise; preserve exact coarse fallback, common requested/resolved graphics policy and world-fixed precision. No external texture asset was imported.
